observations: Indoor unit (evaporator) resting on top of an outdoor unit (condenser).
The word 'inverter' is clearly printed on the outdoor unit in photo 0.
The units appear used and are placed on a tiled floor outdoors.
A brand logo is present on the indoor unit but is too blurry to read.
A technical specification sticker is visible on the outdoor unit but the text is illegible.

claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows 'inverter' text on the outdoor unit; 'faulty' is the seller's admission of condition.

risks.risk: Severity of the fault (e.g., failed compressor or inverter board)
risks.proof: A video of the unit powered on showing the specific error code on the display.
A clear photo of the technical specification sticker (nameplate) on the side of the outdoor unit.

risks.risk: Missing components (remote control, mounting brackets, or copper piping)

proof_requests: Clear photo of the technical specification sticker on the side of the outdoor unit to confirm HP and model.
Video of the unit being powered on to see the error code or behavior.
Photo of the remote control and any included copper piping.
response.reason: The item is identified as a split unit inverter AC. Since the seller explicitly states it is faulty, it must be priced at its worst-case value, which is scrap for parts.
